claimed_coverage: Tests that mx.random.normal does not produce -inf or inf values for half-precision dtypes (float16, bfloat16) by verifying abs(values) < mx.inf for 10000 samples.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix adds above_minus_one() helper in mlx/random.cpp that properly computes the lower bound for half-precision types by manipulating the bit representation, replacing std::nextafter which doesn't handle fp16/bf16 correctly.
issue_context_used: The issue describes that mx.random.normal produces -inf/inf for half-precision dtypes and the test verifies that absolute values are less than mx.inf for 10000 samples.
notes: Updated eval.sh to: 1) Fix activation command to set LD_LIBRARY_PATH before sourcing mlx_activate.sh to avoid set -u errors. 2) Add rebuild step that detects if fix.patch was applied (by checking for above_minus_one in mlx/random.cpp) and rebuilds MLX C++ extension with pip install -e . --no-build-isolation --force-reinstall. This ensures the compiled library matches the source code when the fix is present.
